templates.name: Diwali Rangoli Fireworks
templates.style_title_prompt: Warm cinematic Diwali night portrait of a young person crouching low on a courtyard floor, leaning forward and carefully placing flower petals into a large colorful rangoli with one hand, other arm resting on the knee, head tilted down with a soft, happy, focused smile. Short thick wavy black hair falling slightly over the forehead, defined eyebrows, light stubble, barefoot, a black smartwatch on the wrist. Wearing a cream-ivory embroidered kurta with subtle gold detailing.
templates.style_desc_prompt: Rolled-up sleeves and matching cream churidar pants. Foreground: an intricate flower-petal and powder rangoli with a lotus-style design in magenta, yellow, orange, white and green, scattered rose and marigold petals, lit clay diyas with glowing flames placed around the design. Background: a large white mansion wrapped in thousands of warm fairy string lights, glowing windows, potted plants, rows of diyas along the path, a dark navy night sky with colorful fireworks bursting in pink, gold and green. Shot from a low angle, wide perspective. Warm golden-amber color palette against deep blue night sky, soft diya glow lighting the face and clothes, gentle rim light, golden bokeh, shallow depth of field, subject sharply in focus. Shot on 35mm f/1.8 lens, ultra-detailed skin, fabric, petal and flame texture, joyful, festive, celebratory mood, professional festival lifestyle photography, 16:9 widescreen, 8K, photorealistic, masterpiece.
